_note: Composition A — boutique retail led. Atmospheric product hero, alternating product categories with sourcing stories, split CTA with store hours + 'first visit' welcome.

data.title: Cannabis chosen the way you'd choose wine
data.subtitle: Every flower on the shelf comes from a Wisconsin, Illinois, or Michigan cultivator we've personally visited. Edibles are kitchen-tested. Our budtenders know the lineage of everything they put in your hand.

data.heading: What we carry
data.intro: Four categories. Each one is curated — we don't carry a SKU unless we'd recommend it ourselves.

items.title: Flower
items.description: Indica, sativa, and hybrid from small upper-Midwest cultivators. We rotate the menu monthly so the harvests on the shelf are always within 90 days of cure.
bullets: 12–18 strains in rotation at any time

items.title: Edibles
items.description: Chocolates, gummies, beverages, and baked goods. Every product is dose-tested in our shop kitchen — we taste before we stock.

items.title: Concentrates & vapes
items.description: Live rosin, hash, distillate carts, and rosin-pressed cartridges. Lab tests posted at the register for every batch.
bullets: Full COA available for every concentrate

items.title: Accessories & glass
items.description: Locally-blown glass, premium grinders, storage, papers. The basics done well, plus pieces from a few Wisconsin and Minnesota artisans.
bullets: Storage and curing accessories for serious users

data.heading: First visit? You're in good hands
data.subtitle: Our budtenders don't push, don't upsell, and have all the time in the world to walk you through your first purchase. Bring ID, your questions, and your preferences.
bullets: Daily 10am–9pm · open seven days a week
21+ recreational and registered medical patients welcome
Cash, debit, and on-site ATM. No credit cards (federal banking)
First-visit 10% off — just tell the budtender it's your first time
